WITH transitioned AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET draft_status = CASE $3::text
        WHEN 'approve' THEN 'approved'
        WHEN 'reject' THEN 'rejected'
      END,
      approval_decided_at = NOW(),
      approval_token = NULL
  WHERE id = $1
    AND approval_token = $2::uuid
    AND draft_status = 'pending_approval'
    AND approval_expires_at > NOW()
    AND $3::text IN ('approve', 'reject')
    AND (
      $3::text = 'reject'
      OR (
        NULLIF(BTRIM(email), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(BTRIM(draft_subject), '') IS NOT NULL
        AND NULLIF(BTRIM(draft_body), '') IS NOT NULL
      )
    )
  RETURNING id, email, draft_subject, draft_body, draft_status, approval_decided_at
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transitioned) AS authorized,
  (SELECT id FROM transitioned) AS id,
  (SELECT email FROM transitioned) AS email,
  (SELECT draft_subject FROM transitioned) AS draft_subject,
  (SELECT draft_body FROM transitioned) AS draft_body,
  (SELECT draft_status FROM transitioned) AS draft_status,
  (SELECT approval_decided_at FROM transitioned) AS approval_decided_at;

WITH recorded AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET initial_response_delivery_status = 'sent',
      initial_response_sent_at = NOW(),
      followup_status = CASE WHEN followup_status IS NULL THEN 'scheduled' ELSE followup_status END,
      followup_due_at = CASE WHEN followup_status IS NULL THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '72 hours' ELSE followup_due_at END
  WHERE id = $1::bigint
    AND draft_status = 'approved'
    AND initial_response_sent_at IS NULL
    AND initial_response_delivery_status = 'sending'
    AND initial_response_claim_token = $2::uuid
  RETURNING id, initial_response_delivery_status, initial_response_sent_at
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recorded) AS recorded,
  (SELECT initial_response_delivery_status FROM recorded) AS delivery_status,
  (SELECT initial_response_sent_at::text FROM recorded) AS initial_response_sent_at;

WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS lead_id, gen_random_uuid() AS attempted_claim_token
), transitioned AS (
  UPDATE leads AS lead
  SET initial_response_delivery_status = CASE
        WHEN lead.email ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9.!#$%&''*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?(\.[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?)+$'
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(lead.draft_subject), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND lead.draft_subject !~ '[\r\n]'
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(lead.draft_body), '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'sending'
        ELSE 'failed'
      END,
      initial_response_claim_token = CASE
        WHEN lead.email ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9.!#$%&''*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?(\.[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?)+$'
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(lead.draft_subject), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND lead.draft_subject !~ '[\r\n]'
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(lead.draft_body), '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN candidate.attempted_claim_token
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      initial_response_claimed_at = CASE
        WHEN lead.email ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9.!#$%&''*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?(\.[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?)+$'
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(lead.draft_subject), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND lead.draft_subject !~ '[\r\n]'
          AND NULLIF(BTRIM(lead.draft_body), '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN NOW()
        ELSE NULL
      END
  FROM candidate
  WHERE lead.id = candidate.lead_id
    AND lead.draft_status = 'approved'
    AND lead.initial_response_sent_at IS NULL
    AND lead.initial_response_delivery_status IS NULL
  RETURNING lead.id, lead.email, lead.draft_subject, lead.draft_body,
            lead.initial_response_delivery_status, lead.initial_response_claim_token,
            lead.initial_response_claimed_at
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN transitioned.initial_response_delivery_status = 'sending'
      AND transitioned.initial_response_claim_token = candidate.attempted_claim_token THEN 'owner'
    WHEN transitioned.initial_response_delivery_status = 'failed' THEN 'failed'
    ELSE 'blocked'
  END AS outcome,
  transitioned.id::text AS lead_id,
  transitioned.email,
  transitioned.draft_subject,
  transitioned.draft_body,
  transitioned.initial_response_claim_token::text AS claim_token,
  transitioned.initial_response_claimed_at::text AS claimed_at
FROM candidate
LEFT JOIN transitioned ON TRUE;

WITH recorded AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET initial_response_delivery_status = 'failed'
  WHERE id = $1::bigint
    AND initial_response_sent_at IS NULL
    AND initial_response_delivery_status = 'sending'
    AND initial_response_claim_token = $2::uuid
  RETURNING initial_response_delivery_status
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recorded) AS recorded,
  (SELECT initial_response_delivery_status FROM recorded) AS delivery_status;

WITH recorded AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET initial_response_delivery_status = 'uncertain'
  WHERE id = $1::bigint
    AND initial_response_sent_at IS NULL
    AND initial_response_delivery_status = 'sending'
    AND initial_response_claim_token = $2::uuid
  RETURNING initial_response_delivery_status
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recorded) AS recorded,
  (SELECT initial_response_delivery_status FROM recorded) AS delivery_status;
